notes.title: An Update on Jessica’s Choices – Forced
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I just wanted to give you a quick update, especially for those wondering why there hasn't been much news on [i]Jessica’s Choices – Forced[/i] here on Steam yet.[/p][p]Unfortunately, I’ve hit a few bumps with the Steam review process. The game is going through extended checks due to its mature content and branching narrative. Because of this, I haven't been able to set up the store page or share official info directly through the platform — [i]yet[/i].[/p][p][b]The good news?[/b]
Development is going [i]really well[/i]. The current build of [i]Forced[/i] is already [b]2.47GB[/b], with [b]over 800 brand-new renders[/b], bringing the total in-game render count to [b]2,435[/b] so far. And yes — that includes plenty of bold, intense, and emotional moments that continue directly from where [i]Origins[/i] left off.[/p][p]Here’s just a small taste of what’s coming your way:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/28b9e99989f1e02fd70da3badb4fdea551ade72e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/660c29c4985e9186ddcd5a388872ff113d047101.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/573e94c9437d042acefc9b45d3e916154a1e7c48.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/62d415cccade8992ba0e062f119aeb3eeacc751c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/360226c40db7417654e55f6449e5c6c29f5e826c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/9108165666dd2dcf4ee3256974a9cfa0f5ff429b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support and patience — it really means a lot. I’ll keep you updated as soon as Steam gives the green light on the store page.[/p][p]In the meantime, if you did like [i]Jessica’s Choices – Origins, [/i]please leave a review[i].[/i]
—DoAdventures[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Update Incoming! 🚨
notes.content:
🚨 Update Incoming! 🚨 

I’ve got just three small scenes left to write, and then it’s playtesting time! 😄

This next release is a big one—bringing over 700 new renders, four animations, and pushing the total word count past 80,000. You’ll also notice a fresh new UI, built to better support the growing complexity of the story.

As promised, this will be the final proper release for "Jessica’s Choices – Origins."

Every decision you’ve made throughout the game directly shapes your experience in the sequel, "Forced," and how Jessica’s journey unfolds.

If you've been waiting for the right time to dive back in… this is it. 💥

More soon, and thank you all for your support so far!

notes.title: A Small Request from a Solo Dev – Your Reviews Matter!

[h1]A Small Request from a Solo Dev – Your Reviews Matter![/h1] 💙

Hey everyone,

As a one-man band, I’m incredibly humbled to see my game continue to grow, with more players discovering and enjoying it every day. The support so far has been amazing, and I truly appreciate each and every one of you who has taken the time to play.

But I could really use your help. Reviews mean everything, they help get the game in front of more players, build trust, and show others why they should give it a try. If you've been enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review. Even a few words can go a long way in helping these numbers grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/c17909dd77ae0b6cb5fac16a629e021b0ec1538d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update on the Next Release!
notes.content:
Update on the Next Release!

Hey everyone! 👋

It’s been a while since my last update, so I wanted to share some progress on the next release of Jessica's Choices - Origins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/79279ab4a924a7a5509f9f02e82bc7fe2b17a2cb.jpg[/img]

I’ve completed 285 renders for the upcoming update so far, and everything is shaping up exactly as I have planned. Here’s what you can look forward to:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/98188baa7a6050d9bfa75ac40c39d736bfced019.jpg[/img]

[b]Jessica and Hayley[/b]: What happens when they’re interrupted? You’ll soon find out!
[b]Jessica and Cassie[/b]: The story takes a twist depending on your choice—will Cassie become the slave, or Jessica? The consequences of both paths are will be explored in detail.
[b]Jessica, Michelle, and Ben[/b]: The continuation of this dynamic trio, with a fun interruption from the dog Bruce on the couch. Don’t worry though, they’ll move things to the bedroom soon enough!

[b]Sarah’s Room[/b]: I’m working on the scenes following Jessica sitting on Sarah’s bed, building the emotional weight for what’s happened and how either her brother or sister will impact Jessica.

I’m still fighting with the translations from the last update and subsequent patch to pull them back out, but I’m determined to get them polished and ready for everyone to enjoy!

Stay tuned,

notes.title: Announcement: Progress Update and Upcoming Plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/c011ef5d8fa33c7535758b99738593b26795711a.jpg[/img]

Apologies for the silence over the past few days! I’ve been busy dealing with some technical challenges, including DAZ updates, driver issues, and a few other bumps. Despite this, I’m excited to share some great progress:

For Episode 5, I’ve completed over 150 new renders so far.
On the second game in the series, "Jessica's Choices - Forced," I’ve finished over 100 renders already.
I’m ahead of schedule with renders and have started looking into the implementation of Steam achievements ahead of the next release.
I’m also exploring the addition of Steam trading cards and subsequent badges. One key thing I’m trying to figure out is whether these can be granted retrospectively. My goal is to ensure that existing players don’t have to replay the game just to earn achievements or collect trading cards. If anyone has insight into this, feel free to let me know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/d6c3a39044020ccc592e49bd329baf47ea7f6eed.jpg[/img]

The patch update with the new UI and translations is still on my radar, but I’ll need a bit more time to get it polished and ready for release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/4bf75bc898e2189be6e0eac18840b29f8d58f65b.png[/img]

Lastly, a hiccup with my Steam payout earlier this month (due to an incorrect SWIFT code) delayed plans to upgrade my equipment to increase production. I’m now aiming to revisit those upgrades by the end of this month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/1bfe2eda725d5bc36176987399993b727e3edef2.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for your patience and ongoing support! Your enthusiasm for Jessica’s Choices keeps me motivated, and I’ll share more updates as soon as I can.

Stay tuned!
DoAdventures

notes.title: Episode 4
notes.content:
Changelog
Translations

Added translations for French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, and German.
Issues with translating choice menus and character names will be resolved in a future patch.
Music Implementation

New music system enhances immersion for new games.
Music does not apply to existing saves, but skips remain available for previously played scenes.
🌟 New Features and Content

[list]
[*] Meet Sarah and Her Family: Introduces Sarah, her mother, and sibling (gender based on your choices).
[*] Four Scenarios for Jessica’s Abduction: Unique story paths as George escorts Jessica from the police station.
[*] Michelle and Ben’s Dynamics: Expanded interactions with options for Jessica to engage or withdraw.
[*] Homeless Encounter Aftermath: Choices lead to significant consequences for Jessica's journey.
[*] Old Man/Woman and Cassie: Tense confrontations and the introduction of Cassie, a pivotal new character.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update: Progress Report on Jessica’s Choices – Origins
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/2d786014d7ec646863ed7d22d5f56ce200bf32e6.jpg[/img]

I'm excited to share the latest update on Jessica’s Choices – Origins. Development is moving forward steadily, and as of now, I've completed 348 renders. The creative process is in full swing, and I have at least three more scenes to finalise before the next release. Each scene brings the story closer to crafting the experience I envisioned from the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/647edbdad03dadb5d62deeba7b9a1022aabefd53.jpg[/img]

As the script evolves, I’m continually updating and refining it to capture every layer of Jessica's story. Testing is also well underway, ensuring everything runs smoothly and enhances the player experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/381aa27b0fc375630ff8c38564983761c8769ad1.jpg[/img]

One challenge I’m facing right now is with the in-game music selection feature, which I know many of you are excited about. I want players to enjoy a truly customisable audio experience, picking songs that resonate with each moment of gameplay. However, getting the game to remember those song choices has been challenging. Persistent variables, save configurations, you name it, I’ve tried it. It’s been a journey of trial and error, but I’m committed to getting it right, even if it’s been a bit of a headache!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/d81c9dd9919bd0333d251485d12e0e9597888785.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and patience. Each day brings me closer to release, and I can’t wait for you to experience everything that’s coming together. Keep an eye out for more updates soon!

DoAdventures

notes.title: Jessica's Choices - Origins
notes.content:
[h3]🌟 It's time! 🌟[/h3]

October! You've never looked more beautiful. I'm glad to finally announce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/2d19d313b76070e00473f5aa4480dc7adb46ee8a.jpg[/img]

[b]Jessica’s Choices – Origins[/b] is set to arrive on Steam this month! Step into Jessica's world, where every decision shapes her fate and the future of the three follow-up games: [b]Forced[/b], [b]Prison[/b], and [b]RED[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/9f0debfb9cf8754f312c04db7ab965a81607ba80.jpg[/img]

Dive deep into an intricate narrative where [b]your choices matter[/b]. Will Jessica make allies, fall in love, or walk a darker path? Each decision leads to a unique experience: explore friendship, enmity, innocence, or indulge in the hidden desires of a cruel, unforgiving world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/64409446854c1fa42cd7f39ffc605d205fd8e7f0.jpg[/img]

[b]Experience heartache, passion, acceptance, and growth[/b] as you guide Jessica through a world that both tempts and torments her. Her journey will challenge her boundaries, question her morality, and push you to decide, who will Jessica become?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/c2e27a743826f5851b244b7166022c83bea6a22a.jpg[/img]

While the game is [b]not in early access[/b], it will continue to [b]evolve with regular updates[/b], all provided within this package until the full version is completed — expected by the end of Q1 2025.

Prepare yourself for unforgettable moments and character development as Jessica’s story unfolds in ways that will leave you questioning every choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/d1fd2b8b380f4c347d0d866d164652316ce24bee.jpg[/img]

Keep a look out for the release date to be announced!

Thanks,
DoAdventures
